title: Correctness of the counterexample tree
statement: For every $t\in\mathbb R$, let $f_t:\{-1,1\}^3\to\mathbb R$ be given by $f_t(x)=\frac{t+1}{4}+\frac{t}{4}x_1+\frac{t}{4}x_2-\frac14x_0x_1+\frac14x_0x_2+\frac{t-1}{4}x_1x_2$. The three-coordinate decision tree that first queries coordinate $0$; if $x_0=-1$, queries coordinate $1$, returning $0$ if $x_1=-1$ and otherwise querying coordinate $2$ and returning $1$ if $x_2=-1$ or $t$ if $x_2=1$; if $x_0=1$, queries coordinate $2$, returning $0$ if $x_2=-1$ and otherwise querying coordinate $1$ and returning $1$ if $x_1=-1$ or $t$ if $x_1=1$, computes $f_t$ on every input.
